questions.question: What is Mandela Day, and what are people asked to do on it?
questions.expected_answer: Mandela Day is on the 18th of July, Nelson Mandela's birthday. People are asked to spend sixty-seven minutes helping others, for the sixty-seven years that Mandela spent serving his people, for example by cleaning up, planting trees, collecting food or reading to children.

questions.question: Give three ways a Grade 4 learner can practise the qualities of a good leader.
questions.expected_answer: Listen carefully to others without interrupting. Help at home or help a classmate who is struggling. Do your share in a team. Stand up for someone who is bullied. Keep your promises. Forgive and apologise.

questions.question: What should you think about when voting for a class captain?
questions.expected_answer: Think about whether the person listens, cares about others, works well with a team and is fair and honest, not only whether they are popular or your best friend.
